summary: Added the ratelimit stage (client address resolution, key parts, covering rules, all-or-nothing charging, RateLimit-*/Retry-After headers, summary 'limited') and registered it between auth and upstream. Fixed the already-landed code against the spec: float arithmetic in token-bucket refill, Unicode digits in 'per', stricter CIDR parsing, empty routes/methods lists, case-insensitive duplicate header key parts.
